items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: told me, say, Mario, I don't want to be bothered

ctx.x: Acion -- I think I had the name Acion. So they went to the rehearsal, and I see this (inaudible) go haywire, say, man, this is it. And then he get ready to (inaudible) told me, say, Mario, I don't want to be bothered, because I know they're going to -- next thing they're going to do, they're going to start traveling, and I don't want to be bothered with it. So I say, Chano, how about you? Chano say, no (inaudible). So that's that.
And then, naturally, (inaudible) word from Chano. Chano was a composer. Chano has so many things. So there was -- there was a life (inaudible) Dizzy Gillespie (inaudible) upset everybody.
